name: 0046 block 5 - decoupled rpm sweep, sinus OFF
description: BLOCK 5, sinus filter OFF. MOTOR MUST BE MECHANICALLY DECOUPLED from the rig -- that is the control: it removes bearing and rig vibration, so any noise that scales with rpm while decoupled is ELECTRICAL (drive PWM/EMI), not mechanical. Same logic that settled SP in the 0035 smoke test. With the coupling out the tach mark sits on the rig side and rpm_meas reads 0, so the speed of record is 59.83 x vfd_cmd_hz. 500-3000 rpm in 500 rpm steps, 4 min each, with 4 min at rest before and after as the floor. Ticket 0046 electrical-noise characterization. Same acquisition and scope_channels as a normal run, so blocks compare without rescaling. Heater relay must be OFF for every electrical block (it is its own EMI source, ticket 0035) -- it only comes back as its own factor in block 6.
